# proxmox_qemu_snapshot (Resource)

Manages a Proxmox VE QEMU VM snapshot through `/nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/snapshot`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

resource "proxmox_qemu_snapshot" "pre_deploy" {
  node        = "pve-1"
  vm_id       = 101
  name        = "pre-deploy"
  description = "Snapshot before deploying changes"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Snapshot name. Changes require replacement.
- `node` (String) Proxmox node that owns the VM.
- `vm_id` (Number) Numeric VMID of the VM.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Snapshot description managed through the snapshot config.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform identifier in `node/vm_id/name` form.
- `parent` (String) Parent snapshot name, if any.
- `snaptime` (Number) Unix timestamp when the snapshot was created.
